description: Atlas inventory along a routed drive: every place of a kind within a band of the corridor between two points. This returns the raw record, not a plan — to plan a drive with stops chosen for the traveler, use plan_drive. One limit, stated: ghost-town rows live in a separate Wikidata corpus the corridor read cannot see. Asking for one here is refused rather than answered empty; reach them with search_places by state.

bandMi.description: Miles either side of the route (default 30)

origin.description: Where the drive starts (city or place)

name: places_along_route
title: Places along a route
